_doc: AI Story script (survival). This file scaffolds the 7-beat structure. The daily-shorts-pipeline routine fills in 'text', 'keywords', 'title', 'description' fields at production time, then runs check_script_structure.py to lint, then make_audio_elevenlabs.py + build_visuals_track.py.

beats.label: hook
beats.purpose_hint: Hit Day N + escalation in ≤12 words
beats.text: Day 2. I followed the footprints. They didn't end.

beats.label: setup
beats.purpose_hint: Frame what's happening at this moment
beats.text: They led from the cabin, past the wood pile, into the treeline. I followed them for half an hour.

beats.label: build
beats.purpose_hint: Add stakes — what makes today different
beats.text: The storm came back hard. I lost the trail. The radio crackled to life when I got back inside.
beats.visual_style_hint: tension shot, dutch angle, close detail

beats.label: mid_anchor
beats.purpose_hint: Discovery, threat reveal, or escalation moment
beats.text: A child's voice. Asking for help. Then static. Then nothing.
beats.visual_style_hint: HERO SHOT — Pika clip preferred, dramatic reveal

beats.label: expand
beats.purpose_hint: What does this mean for tomorrow / survival
beats.text: There are no other cabins for thirty miles. There shouldn't be a child out here. There shouldn't be a child on my frequency.

beats.label: payoff
beats.purpose_hint: Resolution beat OR cliffhanger for Day N+1
beats.text: I'm leaving the radio on tonight. I don't know what else to do.
beats.visual_style_hint: wide environmental shot, change of light

beats.label: cta
beats.text: Day 3 tomorrow. If they're still broadcasting.
beats.visual_style_hint: fade-to-loop frame, same composition as hook

character_continuity_hint: [Same protagonist across episodes. Default description: tall man late 30s, weathered face, dark hair, faded blue jacket, dirt-smudged. Include in every Flux prompt to maintain visual continuity. Override per-character in the queue entry's 'Protagonist:' field.]
description_lead: Day 2 of being snowed in. The tracks lead into the trees, then keep going.
hook_template: Day [N] of [scenario]. Today I [escalation in 5-7 words].
spoken_text: Day 2. I followed the footprints. They didn't end. They led from the cabin, past the wood pile, into the treeline. I followed them for half an hour. The storm came back hard. I lost the trail. The radio crackled to life when I got back inside. A child's voice. Asking for help. Then static. Then nothing. There are no other cabins for thirty miles. There shouldn't be a child out here. There shouldn't be a child on my frequency. I'm leaving the radio on tonight. I don't know what else to do. Day 3 tomorrow. If they're still broadcasting.
title: Day 2: The footprints don't end
visual_palette: muted earth tones, high contrast, slightly desaturated, single light source
